accounts_one_per_app.name: accounts_one_per_app
accounts_one_per_app.where: "accounts"."archived_at" is null and "accounts"."notifier_package" is not null

categories_system_key_check.name: categories_system_key_check
categories_system_key_check.value: "categories"."system_key" is null or ("categories"."system_key" = 'salary' and "categories"."kind" = 'income') or ("categories"."system_key" in ('cash', 'unaccounted') and "categories"."kind" = 'spend')

categories_unaccounted_flags_check.name: categories_unaccounted_flags_check
categories_unaccounted_flags_check.value: "categories"."system_key" is distinct from 'unaccounted' or not ("categories"."is_discretionary" or "categories"."is_meal" or "categories"."is_beverage")

transactions_my_share_check.name: transactions_my_share_check
transactions_my_share_check.value: "transactions"."my_share" is null or ("transactions"."kind" = 'spend' and "transactions"."my_share" between 0 and "transactions"."amount")
